newsitem.title: UK: BTR buys Brazilian battery maker for $72 mln.
newsitem.headline: BTR buys Brazilian battery maker for $72 mln.

text.p: British conglomerate BTR plc said on Thursday it had bought the Brazilian industrial battery unit of Germany's Varta AG for $72 million in cash.
BTR said its batteries unit Hawker bought the industrial batteries division of Microlite which will trade as Saturnia Hawker Sistemas de Energia.
Hawker joined BTR in 1991, as part of the acquisition of Hawker Siddeley.
Chris Burns, BTR Executive Director responsible for BTR Process Control, said the acquisition was Hawker's first venture in South America.

"It accords with our global strategy and consolidates our position as the world's leading manufacturer and supplier of industrial batteries. We now operate on every major continent, and provide an unrivalled product offering," Burns said.
